title: Pictogram-comprehension check protocol (M0 reviewer checklist addition)
context: PLAN v0.2 pulls the pictogram-comprehension check forward from M2 field testing into the M0 reviewer checklist. Every reviewer must check that a naive target-language reader (with no context) interprets each icon and any point-to or gesture interaction as intended. This catches cross-cultural misreads (e.g. yes/no head-shake ambiguity; gesture semantics that differ by culture; icons read differently across scripts or familiarity levels) before the pack reaches a field partner. The check is now a required part of every reviewer checklist, not a field-testing nicety. The check result and any comprehension concerns are committed to review.yaml. No task currently covers this protocol; the existing review-001 does not include the pictogram-comprehension check in its acceptance criteria.
objective: Write the pictogram-comprehension check protocol for inclusion in the reviewer checklist and review.yaml, covering naive-reader icon interpretation, gesture/point-to semantics, and cross-cultural ambiguity detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Protocol defines what a reviewer must check: does a naive target-language reader (no context) interpret the icon correctly? Does any point-to or gesture interaction carry unintended meaning in the target culture?

Covers at minimum: yes/no head-shake ambiguity, directional gesture semantics, icon-color meaning (cross-cultural), and familiarity differences for pictogram sets (e.g. standard humanitarian vs. Western-medical icons)
Specifies the review.yaml fields for recording the comprehension-check result and any flagged concerns, and that unresolved concerns block sign-off

Documents a minimal informal comprehension-test protocol for M0/M1 use (before a field partner is secured): e.g. a native/near-native speaker of the target language with no pack context is shown icons in isolation
States that the check applies to every pack from M0, not deferred to M2 field testing
review-001 (reviewer checklist) must reference this protocol
